title: JA Impact wp7 1.0.4: field focus, forms, drawer, back-to-top and footer icons behave and look like the Joomla source
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-impact theme under test (local stand restored from the quickstart pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-impact/j6, installed with its sample data and its web fonts loading; freeze the hit counter of article 12 so Hits chips do not drift between runs).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/visual/site-sweep.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --run-root tasks/ja-impact-wp7 --zip <theme.zip> --concurrency 3 --settle-ms 4000 --out <dir> (all ten checks; about 13 minutes).
S3: Run: node tasks/ja-impact-wp7/tools/measure101.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --out <dir> as the regression group (27 checks of 1.0.1 plus highlight and drawer-back; about 7 minutes).
expect: site-sweep: all ten checks pass with 0 defects on every route; the rows the dossier records as decided (D-13, D-27, D-32, D-39, D-43) are listed as not counted, and the not-measured causes recorded as not-measurable (no-counterpart-section, icon-covered, form-purpose-unknown, touch-control-not-found) carry their hand measurement.
evidence: Sweeps of 05/10/2026 against a local copy of the Joomla source: baseline on the 1.0.3 restore passed 3 of 10 checks (defects in overflow..first-interaction); 1.0.4 on the clean restore passes 10 of 10 with 0 defects
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; decided differences are not asserted to zero
